description: See the boards of everyone on your daemon table: one line per proc (NAME, MODE, DOING, WAITING FOR, BACK; - = none), then a count line. MODE notes (no board), (stale), (asleep). scope deep also walks the tables of procs that are daemons themselves (at most 5 levels and 500 procs). only keeps the rows that are dnd, away, waiting (wait for someone) or waiting_user (wait for the user). Examples: {}, {"only": "waiting_user"}, {"scope": "deep"}. Errors: DaemonMissing, StateMissing, KernelFailed.

scope.description: team = my daemon table (default); deep = also the tables below
